items.title_zh: 美国男子称 Ganesh Chaturthi 庆祝活动为“公共滋扰”。互联网询问：“他们在博里瓦利吗？”
items.title_en: US Man Calls Ganesh Chaturthi Celebration A ‘Public Nuisance’. Internet Asks, ‘Are They In Borivali?’
items.summary_zh: 一名得克萨斯州当地居民批评多尔·塔莎 (Dhol Tasha) 在刘易斯维尔印度集市外的表演，称其为非法行为。
items.summary_en: A local Texas resident criticised Dhol Tasha performance outside India Bazaar in Lewisville by calling it illegal.

items.title_zh: 印度男人和美国妻子因爱情与包办婚姻的玩笑而走红
items.title_en: Indian Man, American Wife Go Viral Over Love Vs Arranged Marriage Banter
items.summary_zh: 迪帕克和汉娜的一段病毒视频幽默地对比了印度和美国人的婚姻观。迪帕克拿包办婚姻开玩笑，汉娜则提出一些奇怪的问题。
items.summary_en: A viral video by Deepak and Hannah humorously contrasts Indian and American views on marriage. Deepak jokes about arranged marriage, while Hannah shares quirky questions.

items.title_zh: 阿尼鲁达查亚 (Aniruddhacharya) 面临更多麻烦？他的“父亲”被“虐待”的视频在网上疯传|真相是什么？
items.title_en: More Trouble For Aniruddhacharya? Viral Video Of His ‘Father’ Being ‘Mistreated’ | What’s The Truth?
items.summary_zh: 拉姆·纳雷什·蒂瓦里 (Ram Naresh Tiwari) 指控工作人员受到虐待，并已向莫迪总理、UP CM Yogi Adityanath 和马图拉政府寻求援助。
items.summary_en: Ram Naresh Tiwari has alleged mistreatment by staff members and has appealed to PM Modi, UP CM Yogi Adityanath, and the Mathura administration for assistance.
